notes: Neutral outcome labels jointly identify the four gender-comparison rows of original Table 1 (PDF p. 7); the supplied original locator p. 8 is offset from that table in this copy. Printed partial η2 retained without conversion to requested d. Original Table 1 gives outcome df (1,150), but does not explicitly print analytic n; overall 165 was not substituted. Replication Table C1 contains means and SDs, not gender-comparison effect sizes or significance tests. Table C2 correlations and the authors’ narrative successful replication of the IAT predictive advantage concern different tests and were not substituted. The replication IAT/explicit stereotype scores are coded science–male, whereas original Table 1 refers to science–own gender; exact target-test equivalence remains unverified. No test-specific author narrative verdict located.
